species: the protein search was performed against Homo sapiens database (downloaded from Uniprot) using Proteome Discoverer 2.2.
cell_type: In all the cell lines tested, post DSB induction, GCN5 was enriched at DSBs, along with being localized to other areas within the nucleus.
